scripts.setup: uv sync --locked && npm ci && npm run contracts && npm run seed
scripts.dev:server: uv run uvicorn server.app.main:app --reload --reload-dir server --reload-dir scripts --reload-dir agents --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.contracts: uv run python -m scripts.export_contracts && openapi-typescript contracts/openapi.json -o ui/src/api.generated.ts
scripts.check: uv run ruff check server scripts agents && uv run pytest && npm run test --workspace ui && npm run build --workspace ui
